requirements: Trailing Stop with fixed quantity, callback 0.1–5 percent, optional activation and Last/Mark
Trailing order confirmation and reducing-position support

public_exchange_capability.scope: Capability shape only; no wallet authorization, activation, tracking, order placement or execution is proved.

native_testing: Skipped at user request. No device tools, device tests or APK installation. See ../native-verification-pending.md.
ios: Linux has no macOS/Xcode; build and native flows unverified.
implementation: Immutable trailing intent; fixed base quantity, callbackRate, workingType and optional activationPrice. Omit price, stopPrice, priceProtect, timeInForce and closePosition.

Decimal callback bounds 0.1 through 5 percent, general LOT_SIZE, quantity/notional/funds limits, symbol orderTypes, explicit activation price bounds/ticks and buy-below/sell-above checks against matching Last/Mark.

Default activation is omitted from signed POST and resolved by exchange at placement. Query validates its returned positive decimal without pinning it to an earlier snapshot. Explicit activation must match exactly.
One-way reductions use reduceOnly; hedge reductions retain original LONG/SHORT and opposite side. Dedicated position reductions independently recheck the reviewed position/configuration before POST.

Same EOA signs exact POST and separate original-ID GET; no additional wallet. Query verifies origType, trailing/triggered-market type, rate, basis, activation, flags, default GTC, requested quantity and reported execution.
Unknown outcome keeps frozen intent and GET-only recovery. Late/refused signatures and changed positions cannot cross POST boundary. POST acknowledgement is not evidence of execution.

Preview/cancel/refresh preserve fields; unsupported capabilities block review, unknown results lock inputs. Mode changes omit dormant trigger/trailing values. Mark-only reference notional/margin has clear limits; no closing PnL estimate without a fixed execution price.

Chinese and English 320-width, 1.5 text scaling and landscape confirmation/recovery checks passed. Scope text includes ordinary/conditional/trailing modes and distinguishes fixed-size reductions from entire close.
evidence: Full regression suite covers existing authentication, funds, policies, conditional/entire orders, batch closing, markets and localization.
boundaries: Trailing Stop is exchange-managed market execution after favorable extreme tracking and callback; it is not a Chase repricing strategy.
No closePosition=true or attached TP/SL is supported for trailing orders. Fixed quantity can become ineligible as position/account state changes.
Aster enable-trading is not implemented; same-EOA API signer acceptance remains unverified.

Chase, BBO, attached TP/SL and linkage/editing, Scaled, chart quick entry, subaccounts, funding/withdrawals/transfers, full valuation, notifications and durable unresolved-order recovery remain incomplete.
Scaled distribution, split-count/interval and remainder rules remain to be confirmed from product evidence.
BAPI historical statistics and TWAP skipped this phase at user request.
